description: Helios ECLSS simulator + agent runtime. V0.1.1 is deliberately empty: the V0.1 sub-plugins shipped generic primitives that were relocated to Logic.Sim, Logic.Event, DSP.Sensor, Control.Actuator, and Control.Safety. V0.2 will refill with chemistry plant nodes (Helios.Process), ECLSS-specific agent wrappers (Helios.Agent), comm (Helios.Comm) and sim infrastructure (Helios.Sim) once the ISimNode framework lands.
